declarations.type:
∀ {MembershipDigest AuthorityId EpochId Attestation : Type}
  (policy :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFaultBoundAuthority.FaultBoundAuthorityPolicy MembershipDigest
      AuthorityId EpochId Attestation)
  (snapshot :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFaultBoundAuthority.FaultBoundSnapshot MembershipDigest AuthorityId
      EpochId Attestation),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFaultBoundAuthority.FaultBoundSnapshotValid policy snapshot →
    policy.actualFaultWeight ≤ snapshot.declaredFaultBound
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFaultBoundAuthority.valid_snapshot_bounds_actual_fault_weight

declarations.type:
∀ {MembershipDigest AuthorityId EpochId Attestation : Type}
  (policy :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFaultBoundAuthority.FaultBoundAuthorityPolicy MembershipDigest
      AuthorityId EpochId Attestation)
  (snapshot :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFaultBoundAuthority.FaultBoundSnapshot MembershipDigest AuthorityId
      EpochId Attestation),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFaultBoundAuthority.FaultBoundSnapshotValid policy snapshot →
    snapshot.membershipDigest = policy.expectedMembershipDigest ∧ snapshot.epochId = policy.expectedEpochId
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFaultBoundAuthority.valid_snapshot_matches_membership_and_epoch

declarations.type:
∀ {MembershipDigest AuthorityId EpochId Attestation : Type}
  (policy :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFaultBoundAuthority.FaultBoundAuthorityPolicy MembershipDigest
      AuthorityId EpochId Attestation)
  (snapshot :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFaultBoundAuthority.FaultBoundSnapshot MembershipDigest AuthorityId
      EpochId Attestation),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFaultBoundAuthority.FaultBoundSnapshotValid policy snapshot →
    snapshot.issuedAt ≤ policy.evaluationTime ∧ policy.evaluationTime < snapshot.expiresAt
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFaultBoundAuthority.valid_snapshot_is_current_at_evaluation_time

declarations.type:
∀ (scheme : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.CanonicalMembershipScheme)
  (membershipPolicy : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.MembershipPolicy)
  (left right : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.QuorumCertificate scheme)
  (accounting :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumIntersection.PairWeightAccounting membershipPolicy left.signers
      right.signers)
  {AuthorityId EpochId Attestation : Type}
  (authorityPolicy :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFaultBoundAuthority.FaultBoundAuthorityPolicy scheme.Digest AuthorityId
      EpochId Attestation)
  (snapshot :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFaultBoundAuthority.FaultBoundSnapshot scheme.Digest AuthorityId
      EpochId Attestation),
  authorityPolicy.expectedMembershipDigest =
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.membershipDigest scheme membershipPolicy →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFaultBoundAuthority.FaultBoundSnapshotValid authorityPolicy snapshot →
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.totalVotingWeight membershipPolicy +
            snapshot.declaredFaultBound <
          membershipPolicy.quorumWeight + membershipPolicy.quorumWeight →
        ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.AcceptsQuorumCertificate scheme membershipPolicy
            left →
          ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.AcceptsQuorumCertificate scheme
              membershipPolicy right →
            authorityPolicy.actualFaultWeight < accounting.intersectionWeight ∧
              snapshot.membershipDigest =
                ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.membershipDigest scheme
                  membershipPolicy
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFaultBoundAuthority.authorized_current_bound_forces_actual_honest_overlap
